title: Quarterly initiative: slicing Private/VPC/On‑Prem deliverables and risk mitigation
creator: Arielle Chen
description: This ticket captures the quarterly roadmap slicing and execution plan for Private (VPC + on‑prem) enterprise features. Goal: deliver a clear, risk‑aware sequence of payloads that enable 4 primary customer scenarios (regulated SaaS, finance, healthcare, air‑gapped telco), reduce upgrade friction, and provide standardized rollout playbooks for Sales + CSMs. Focus areas: install/operator UX, KMS/HSM integrations, upgrade orchestration, observability exports for offline environments, and packaging the compliance bundle for EU/UK customers.
goals: Agree on ordered delivery of 6 product slices that can be independently released
Reduce on‑prem upgrade failure rate from estimated 12% -> <=4% via preflight checks and canary tooling
Ship KMS/HSM integration beta + audit logging for 2 reference customers
Publish CS/SE playbook and a self‑serve QuickStart for non‑airgapped VPC installs
milestones: M1: Slicing sign‑off and customer scenario alignment (2026-01-22)
M5: Public QuickStart and SE playbook (2026-03-24)
acceptance_criteria: All 6 slices have a tracked PRD, top‑level implementation owners, QA criteria, and a live runbook. Preflight checks run end‑to‑end in CI for both airgapped and VPC installs. KMS integration validated with two key types (AWS KMS and an HSM simulator) and audit log delivery verified to SIEM in a staging environment.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Operator stability across diverse customer kernels -> Mitigation: limit supported OS/kernel combos for GA, provide e2e tested images and rollback hooks
Risk: Compliance/regulatory delays for EU customers -> Mitigation: ship compliance bundle as optional add‑on and prioritize documentation for cert teams
Risk: KMS/HSM edge cases -> Mitigation: vendor integration tests + reference implementation and clear fallback to envelope encryption
Risk: On‑prem networking complexity for customers -> Mitigation: standardized network prerequisites checklist and managed CSM assistance program for P0 customers
tradeoffs_considered: Tradeoff: Broad platform support vs. reliable GA — chose to gate some OS/infra targets to narrow surface at GA to ensure stability
Tradeoff: Automate everything vs. ship sooner — decided to ship a manual SE playbook alongside automation to unblock customers while automation matures
Tradeoff: Embedded private control plane vs. customer‑managed control plane — prioritize customer‑managed for Q1 due to compliance concerns, evaluate hosted control plane later
stakeholder_feedback: Design review (2026-01-18): DES-412 mockups accepted with request for clearer error states during cluster bootstrap
Security review (2026-01-25): Mark Hale requested threat model update for KMS key rotation flows
Sales/CS sync (2026-02-04): Field asked for downloadable checklist and a one‑pager for procurement teams
implementation_notes: Slice definitions: 1) Install & operator + QuickStart, 2) Upgrade orchestration & preflight, 3) KMS/HSM + audit log, 4) Telemetry export for offline environments, 5) Compliance bundle (EU/UK), 6) Customer onboarding templates and runbooks
Preflight checks: disk, ports, firewall, time sync, kernel modules, available GPU drivers; run in CI with mocked environment before canary
Canary plan: 10% of upgrade ops on dedicated staging mesh, automatic rollback on key metrics (latency, error rate, KV cache miss spike)
QA: Create e2e matrices for each slice and add nightly run for core scenarios; tag tests that require hardware emulation
